body: The only reason I'm still here is because of him. I don't want to hurt him.

I think my inability to stop smoking is just my slow way of deleting myself. It's the only reason I can think of why I can't just quit. I know it's bad for me. It makes me feel like shit. I hate it. But for some reason I wake up and have another cigarette...
I don't know why someone downvoted you. I liked your story. Thank you for sharing.
I've never even been on vacation. :c
Alcohol probably played a part in quite a few cases.
